dedupe_keys.name: 避難施設一覧 指定避難所 evacuation shelters and public facilities

description: 避難施設一覧(指定避難所) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大津市. 災害の危険性があり避難した方や、災害により家に戻れなくなった方を滞在させるための施設として『指定避難所』を指定しています。. Coverage: 大津市. The portal files it under the publisher 大津市. Its tags are 災害, 避難所, 防災. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, rdf. The portal shows 2025-03-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
